questions.question: The product of two numbers is 38025 and their Highest Common Factor is 65. What is the Least Common Multiple of these numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Product of two numbers = 38025

Highest common factor (H.C.F) = 65

**Formula used:**

Product of two numbers = H.C.F × L.C.M

**Calculation:**

H.C.F × L.C.M = product of two numbers

⇒ 65 × L.C.M = 38025

⇒ Least Common Multiple (L.C.M) = 38025/65 = 585

**∴ The correct answer is 585.**

questions.solution:

⇒ 35 : 42 = 5 : 6

**∴ The correct option is 5 : 6.**

questions.question: A alone can complete a work in 16 days and B alone can complete the same work in 96 days. In how many days both A and B together can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given: 

A and B can do a work in 16 and 96 days respectively.

They began the work together.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let the total work is the 96 units (LCM of 16 and 96)

The efficiency of A is 96 / 16 = 6 units

The efficiency of B is 96 / 96 = 1 unit

Total efficiency 6 + 1 = 7 units 

Total time taken by them together is 96 / 7 days

**∴ The correct option is 2**

questions.question: A bag contains Rs. 840 in the form of 2 rupee, 5 rupee and 10 rupee coins. The number of coins of 2 rupee, 5 rupee and 10 rupee are in the ratio of 5 : 7 : 6. What is the total number of coins in the bag?
questions.solution:
Given:

Ratio of coins of Rs. 2, Rs. 5, and Rs. 10 = 5 ∶ 7 ∶ 6

Formula Used:

Total rupees = Number of coins × Value of the coin

Calculation:

According to the ratio given:

Let the 2 rupee, 5 rupee and 10 rupee coin be = 5x, 7x and 6x respectively

Total rupees = Rs. 840

⇒ 5x × 2 + 7x × 5 + 6x × 10 = Rs. 840

⇒ 105x = 840

⇒ x = 840/105

⇒ x = 8

The total number of coins in the bag = 5x + 7x + 6x = 18x

18x → 18 × 8 = 144

**The total number of coins in the bag is 144**

questions.question: The average weight of A, B and C is 40 kg. If the average weight of A and B is 35 kg and that of B and C is 31 kg, then what is the weight of B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of A, B, and C is = 40 kg 

The average weight of A and B is = 35 kg

The average weight of B and C = is = 31 kg

**Formula used:**

Average={Sum of all itemsover Total number of items}

**Calculation:**

Let the weight of the B is B

According to the question

The total weight of A, B, and C = 40 × 3 = 120 kg ----(1)

The total weight of A and B is = 35 × 2 = 70 kg ----(2)

The total weight of B and C = 31 × 2 = 62 kg ------(3)

By equation (2) and (3)

⇒ A + B + B + C = 70 + 62 = 132 kg

In which one extra B added

⇒ A + 2B + C - (A + B + C) = 132 - 120

⇒ A + B + B + C - A - B - C = 12 

⇒ B = 12 kg

**∴ The required result will be 12 kg.**

questions.question: What is the simple interest on Rs. 14400 for 12 months, if the rate of the interest be 11% per annum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the time is exactly 12 months (which is equal to 1 full year), the simple interest is calculated directly as the percentage of the principal.

Simple Interest = 11% of 14400

SI = 11 × 144 = 1584

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1584.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹14400

Rate of Interest (R) = 11% per annum

Time (T) = 12 months = 1 year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bc60331c3848a052b6cd507d1869333904a436b29f022eac043deaedf4c1153.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = (14400 × 11 × 1) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 144 × 11

⇒ SI = 1584

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1584.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount in Simple Interest

The total amount received at the end of the period is the sum of the Principal and Simple Interest: A = P + SI.

Fractional Time Periods

If time is given in months, it must be converted to years by dividing by 12. If time is given in days, divide by 365 (or 366 in leap years) before applying the standard formula.

Simple vs Compound Interest

Simple Interest is calculated only on the initial principal. Compound interest is calculated on both the principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods.

Rule of 72

A quick mental math shortcut to estimate how long it takes an investment to double in value is to divide 72 by the annual interest rate (Time ≈ 72 ÷ R).

questions.question: Ajay buys a scooter for Rs. 7560 and spends Rs. 540 on its repair. He sells it for Rs. 9000. What is his gain percent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost price of scooter = Rs. 7560

He spends on repair = 540

The selling price = 9000

**Formula used:**

P = SP - CP Where, P = Profit, SP = Selling price, and CP = Cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the profit is X

The cost price of scooter for Ajay = 7560 + 540 = 8100

The selling price of the scooter for Ajay = 9000

The profit = 9000 - 8100 = 900

The profit % = {900over8100}×100=11.11\%

**∴ The required result will be 11.11%.**
